title: Prove the fixed-core J caller joint cleanup support bound
body:
The phase-correct J caller now has a complete original-input cleanup and a scoped joint-tail lower bound. For q>=2 the exact all-q telescope `C R=F_k J` leaves only q native factors in R, even for arbitrary physical source monomials. Hence a complete native/monomial/binary-ADD tail needs total native arity plus ADD count at least `(2q+4)f`.

Under explicit paid full-bank scans, sublinear retained local tolls cannot hide a linear native-arity deficit in ADDs. With the additional equal-volume full-bank native-child normalization, including queried dirty helpers, the completed fixed-prefix mass is at least stock+4 and has no favorable proper-child moment. Unequal queried-bank volumes need a separate actual weighted bridge.

The package also supplies a conservative complete J caller: all public L-readers are scalar, every original field is restored to its actual `F_k J` output, and the full invoice is `H[2]=n^2+1, H[4]=2, H[6]=1`, mass=stock+16. Exact q2/q3 fixtures retain both inverse orders, all Gaussian f residues and every selected-native query. The all-q written derivations, finite checks and inherited C37/C38 resource/factory gates remain distinct.

Validation at `efb1b5a56a52967a4e94223bcdd03b209f4f09f5`:

- Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replay, with historical assertions preserved.
- Exact committed bytes, source history, official export and integrity check.
- Read-only Git-free export, isolated normal/optimized Python with empty PATH; unchanged source bytes, modes and inodes.
- Every fixed native witness is independently reconstructed and checked against signed Pauli images and an exact Gaussian source column. Every forward/inverse event ID, embedding, phase tag and rank is checked. Wrong phase/rank and the preserved pre-fix inverse-recipe-pointer receipt reject; an equivalent compensated phase gauge passes.

`research/phase-correct-j-handoff/README.md` gives the model, proofs, reproducible commands, source pins and next concrete question. `REPLAY-MAP.md` maps generation-time assertions to the fixed-witness verifier. A separate Codex review replayed this exact head normally and with -O, and reviewed the proof, fixed-witness checker, evidence reconstruction and documented scope. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

No new κ, selected-record change, global caller impossibility, formal-kernel proof, physical precision/owner/tape admission or compatible BIT result is claimed. Changed core/continuation/delivery, cross-cut query fusion, different target/owner contracts and different volume transfers remain outside the theorem. Earlier 3630/3632/3645/3649/3655 and separate BIT 4021/4023 are credited. Generic signed-lift/phase work in 3987/4002 and related interface/volume work in 3989/4045 remain their authors' contributions. Full attribution, inherited notices and Apache-2.0 license are retained. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed.

The full natural [Registered research packages workflow39253030363](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39253030363) is **completed/success** at exact head `efb1b5a56a52967a4e94223bcdd03b209f4f09f5`. Full workflow status/conclusion and source-head SHA were read back separately from local validation. No manual rerun or check request was made; no merge is requested.
